text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Eishin Flash wants to go shopping, so we
stop by
the shopping mall on our way
home.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Thank you for accompanying me.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I wish to purchase thank-you gifts for
people who
have helped me during my
time in Japan. I have
been saving up for
this occasion.
choice_data_list: ちなみに何を買う予定？

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I have a list of what I'd like to get, so
this should
not take long. Let's be on our
way.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
A comfortable pillow for Falcon, a clutch
purse
for Jordan...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
A Moai statue for Golshi... A tumbler for

Nakayama...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Now, only one gift remains. I'm surprised
I'm still
under budget.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: You, of course.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Of course I do. You have helped me
more than
anyone.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Is there anything in particular you would
like? My
budget is now higher than
anticipated, so I'm
open to requests.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Is there anything in particular you would
like? My
budget is now higher than
anticipated, so I'm
open to requests.
choice_data_list: いろいろ見て決めたい
君が選んでくれたものならなんでも！
貴方が選んでくれたものならなんでも！

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Very well. Let's find something together.
choice_data_list: いろいろ見て決めたい
君が選んでくれたものならなんでも！
貴方が選んでくれたものならなんでも！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We browse for a while until suddenly, I
notice
Eishin Flash staring intently at
one particular
item.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's a stopwatch decorated with
ladybugs. Now
that I think about it,
Eishin Flash does love
ladybugs...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Oh. Excuse me. I didn't mean to get
distracted...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Huh? You've taken a liking to it as well?
choice_data_list: ……そのストップウォッチにしよう

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Wait... Can it be you are planning to
regift it to
me?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Of course I did. You are kind as always.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: However, this is supposed to be a gift of gratitude for you.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
So as happy as I am for your
thoughtfulness—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
choice_data_list: その嬉しさを贈り物ということに

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Very well. Then I shall graciously
accept your
kindness...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I shall treasure it with my whole heart.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Eishin Flash carries the stopwatch to the
register
with a truly priceless smile.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Here you go...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She hands me the stopwatch, and then I
present it
back to her.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Wait a moment. Before we do—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Please accept this.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Open it. You'll see.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I do as she says and discover a picture
frame
inside.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't ignore my desire to gift you
something,
you see...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
There is a particular picture I wish for
you to put
in that frame.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The picture we'll take together to
commemorate
my victory at a race.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I believe that would be the best proof
that I have
achieved what I must—and
the gift that would
bring you the most
joy.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Please look forward to that day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After receiving such a wonderful present
from
Eishin Flash, I feel even more
determined to work
hard together with
her.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Anything, you say? But I want to choose

something that I know you will like...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Hmm. What a predicament.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Please be patient. I shall find the perfect
gift for
you within the next twelve
minutes, thirty
seconds.
choice_data_list: そんなに深く考えなくても――

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Eishin Flash takes off before I can try to
stop her.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Seven minutes, eighteen seconds remain.
Hmm...
I'm struggling to find the right
gift...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
No, I mustn't fret. Toi, toi, toi... I should
return to
the floor map and think it
over...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hi! I thought that was you, Flash! ♪
Never
thought I'd bump into you here!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You're by yourself? But this
morning you
told me you were going to
be hanging out with
your trainer...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Falcon. That is true, but I am
currently—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, okay! So you're looking for
something to
get your trainer, huh?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Not too long ago, we were watching TV
when the
trainer took a liking to the
Arita ware teacups
they were
showcasing...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
But then again, there was the fancy
table lamp
they introduced in the
Scandinavian-themed
program too...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Taking such remarks into consideration,
the
perfect gift must be... No, there must
be
something else... Hm...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Umm... Aren't you overthinking this?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, my thoughts are in gridlock.
Only five
minutes, twenty-eight seconds
remain... Will I be
able to find a suitable
gift in time?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Well, at times like this, you
should...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Thank you for your patience, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Here... Please accept this gift.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It's a cake. As the daughter of pastry
chefs, I can
attest to the quality of the
patisserie where I
purchased this.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure, well... I think you will like how
it tastes.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I can only hope this is a satisfactory
gift...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Oh! What a relief...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yay! I'm so glad it worked out! Good for
you!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Your advice was most
helpful, Falcon.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! Aren't I just the best? When it
comes to
stuff like this, you don't have
go for a perfect
score or anything.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It was just like you said—it's the thought
that
counts. Clearly conveying my
sincerity was all I
needed to do.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I hope Trainer is enjoying the cake right
now.
